tbesh_html:
1) water skin bottle
2) necromancer
1b) necromancer, one who evokes the dead
1c) ghost, spirit of a dead one
1d) practice of necromancy
3) one that has a familiar spirit

strongs_1890.strongs_def: properly, a mumble, i.e. a water skin (from its hollow sound); hence a necromancer (ventriloquist, as from a jar)
strongs_1890.derivation: from the same as H1 (אָב) (apparently through the idea of prattling a father's name);
